repositoryReview.assessment: The Zenodo record names a specific CC BY 4.0 license and is managed by Plazi. The public record does not identify which rights holder authorized that license.

plaziDataReview.overviewStatement: Plazi says all data in the Biodiversity Literature Repository is published under CC0.
plaziDataReview.curationPolicyStatement: The community policy says open-access items remain open access and advises checking national copyright law for reuse; it does not establish the rights chain for this article.
plaziDataReview.retrievalOutcome: The linked table URLs redirected to a missing Plazi route. The public TreatmentBank lookup for the three identifiers returned a generic page stating that the document contains no treatments; no separate table file or usable CC0 taxon dataset was retrieved.
plaziDataReview.assessment: The repository-wide CC0 statement is a lead for separately liberated data. It does not by itself prove that this attached source.pdf or the article's species table was authorized for redistribution under CC0.

publisherRightsReview.publisherPdfCopyrightNotice: The article PDF displays © National University of Singapore.
publisherRightsReview.currentPublisherTerms: RBZ says articles are freely downloadable for non-commercial purposes; the author instructions require a copyright-transfer agreement and say copyright remains with the publisher.
publisherRightsReview.assessment: These publisher statements do not explain the relationship to the CC BY 4.0 label on the Plazi-managed Zenodo record. No author, publisher or repository statement confirming the applicable article/table reuse grant was found in this bounded review.

limits: The article is a historical wet-season survey from 2010 and 2011; it is not a present-day census.
The source's six species-rank and two genus-only Iyam rows remain unchanged in the earlier review; no table content was copied in this follow-up.
No current-presence, complete-checklist, abundance, catchability, diet, bait, food-safety, fishing-permission, geometry, or salinity claim follows from this rights review.
nextAction: Keep the Iyam species table held unless the publisher/repository confirms the CC BY grant or an independently retrievable Plazi CC0 dataset is located. Continue the other Quezon/CALABARZON freshwater and coastal source queue without waiting for that clarification.
